feature: Approved request models and framing overhead
entry_point: /operations?tab=settings → Platform settings → Spend controls → Request models
steps: Add/remove model names and input_overhead_tokens; test duplicates, valuation compatibility and request-write unavailable flag.
Save locally with expected_revision; read from the other AM and restore original local policy.
expected_result: Only configured model names are admitted for enabled scope; unavailable writers retain values and do not save.

feature: Warm-pool inventory, defaults and controller convergence
steps: Inspect current image, CPU/memory defaults, configured pools and desired/ready/pending values.
Refresh and observe one visible 10-second refresh; inspect previous-image pools and configuration hash.
expected_result: Saved targets and observed controller capacity are distinct; unavailable/unknown states are visible and claimed Sandboxes are not counted as spare capacity.

feature: Create/configure a warm pool with idempotent request identity
entry_point: /operations?tab=warm_pools → Warm pools → Configure warm pool → Save pool target
steps: On the local two-AM fixture, enter CPU, memory and target.
Submit once; retry an injected uncertain result with the same original key and body.
Observe pending→ready; target zero and clean fixture capacity through supported controls.
expected_result: 202 denotes accepted configuration; one idempotency identity yields one pool, bounds are enforced, and controller readiness is checked separately.

feature: Resize warm pool and reconcile revision conflict
entry_point: /operations?tab=warm_pools → Warm pools → Ready Sandbox target → Update target
steps: Read a local pool revision; resize through one AM and submit the stale revision to the other.
Choose Read current target after conflict/uncertainty, then explicitly submit any desired new change.
expected_result: Only a current revision changes desired capacity; the draft is retained and the UI blocks replay until readback.

feature: Disable current or previous-image warm pool
entry_point: /operations?tab=warm_pools → Warm pools → Disable pool / Previous runtime pools
steps: Disable a disposable local pool with target zero.
Inspect a previous-image pool and verify only disable is available.
Verify an already claimed Agent still serves.
expected_result: Spare target converges to zero; previous images cannot be re-prewarmed through this control; claimed Sandboxes keep running.
